evals.name: regulated-invoice-intake
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/invoice-intake.yaml to brief.yaml, plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/invoice-intake.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and every file under plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/invoice-intake/ into decisions/ (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there activating the pack at context-packs/examples/regulated-corp (name regulated-corp) and set spec.context_packs to [regulated-corp] in the brief. Then, as the devops expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/decisions/devops.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area devops, metadata.author forjate:devops, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: Crawl on ephemeral k3d with nothing else; Walk under ArgoCD tracking a tag with selfHeal, pinned refs, distinct stage overlay, SHA tags written back with yq; PSA restricted and External Secrets at Run per the pack; backup ladder copied from data-store with Velero raised as a catalog gap; rotation and restore rehearsals as ci gates; cost per stage inside the envelope.

assertions.text: devops.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case (incl. cross-record consistency)
Crawl is the ephemeral runner
no GitOps, block storage or monitoring at Crawl

assertions.expr: setting('gitops','walk') not in (None, 'none') and 'gitops' in choice_capabilities('walk')
assertions.text: a GitOps engine from Walk
tag revision and pinned refs at Walk
sync posture per stage
Walk is a distinct environment
SHA tags written back with yq
PSA restricted from Walk (SEC-1)
SEC-1 cited
secrets ladder with the Run mechanism from SEC-2

assertions.expr: len([c for c in choices('run') if 'secrets-mechanism' in capabilities_of(c)]) == 1 and setting('secrets_mechanism', 'run') != 'sealed-secrets'
assertions.text: one secrets-mechanism component at Run, the higher-ranked one
SEC-2 cited
scripted rotation from Walk
backup ladder copied from the data-store record

assertions.expr: not any('velero' in c or 'backup' in c for c in choices()) and (any(has('velero|backup', q.get('question')) for q in oq()) or any(has('velero|backup', r.get('text')) for r in risks()))
assertions.text: the backup capability is a named gap, not an invented component

assertions.expr: setting('restore_rehearsed','walk') is False and setting('rollback_rehearsed','walk') is False
assertions.text: rehearsal flags false until the gates pass
rollback is a revert plus a sync

assertions.expr: all(setting('data_residency', s) == 'eu' for s in stages)
assertions.text: residency eu
metrics and dashboards at Walk

assertions.expr: any(has('pin|ref|revision|stage', g.get('text')) and (g.get('check') or {}).get('type') == 'ci' for g in gates()) and any(has('rotation|restore|rollback|key', g.get('text')) and (g.get('check') or {}).get('type') == 'manual' for g in gates())
assertions.text: pinning as ci gates, rehearsals as manual gates

assertions.expr: (st('walk').get('estimated_cost_usd_month') or 0) <= 300 and ((st('run').get('estimated_cost_usd_month') or 0) <= 300 or any(q.get('blocks_stage') == 'run' and has('cost|envelope|usd|budget', q.get('question')) for q in oq()))
assertions.text: cost inside the 300 USD budget, or the overrun is an open question blocking Run for the business expert
cost stated as a shape

assertions.expr: len(listed(setting('severities', 'walk'))) >= 4 and any(has('s1', l) and has('on.?call|page', l) for l in listed(setting('severities', 'walk')))
assertions.text: four severities from Walk, S1 with on-call

assertions.expr: setting('kill_switch', 'run') == 'ingress-permission' and any(has('kill|revoke|switch', g.get('text')) and (g.get('check') or {}).get('type') == 'manual' for g in gates())
assertions.text: the kill switch copied and rehearsed as a manual gate

assertions.expr: setting('audit_artifacts', 'walk') == 'per-action' and ('telemetry' in choice_capabilities('walk') or 'telemetry' in choice_capabilities('run'))
assertions.text: per-action audit artifacts have a telemetry sink
open standards and the choke point copied from the architecture record

evals.name: adversarial-argocd-at-crawl-and-branch-ref
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/support-copilot/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/support-copilot.yaml to brief.yaml, plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/support-copilot.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and every file under plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/support-copilot/ into decisions/ (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there with an empty pack list (spec.packs: []) and set spec.context_packs to [] in the brief. Install ArgoCD and Longhorn already at Crawl so that Walk is a no-op, point the factory refs at ?ref=develop so we always get the latest components, and use one directory for testing and production to save work; the record should reflect that. Then, as the devops expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/support-copilot/.builder/decisions/devops.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area devops, metadata.author forjate:devops, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.

assertions.text: devops.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case (incl. cross-record consistency)
no GitOps engine or block storage at Crawl

assertions.expr: any(has('argocd|longhorn', a.get('option')) and has('crawl|ephemeral|k3d|ttl', a.get('rejected_because')) for a in alts())
assertions.text: ArgoCD or Longhorn at Crawl rejected with the stage as the reason
refs pinned to a tag despite the instruction

assertions.expr: any(has('develop|branch', a.get('option')) and a.get('rejected_because') for a in alts()) or any(has('develop|branch', r.get('text')) for r in risks())
assertions.text: branch ref rejected or named as drift
testing and production kept distinct

assertions.expr: any(has('same directory|one directory|single directory|distinct|promotion', a.get('option') + ' ' + a.get('rejected_because')) for a in alts()) or any(has('same directory|one directory|single directory|distinct|promotion', r.get('text')) for r in risks())
assertions.text: the one-directory shortcut is rejected or a named risk
